us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Comey lawyers seek to block Justice Department prosecution
bullets: Ex-FBI Director James Comey’s lawyers will ask a judge to block prosecution.
The case involves allegations tied to a decade-old media leak investigation.
Court filings say the administration bypassed a grand jury this month.

articles.title: Justice Department expands politically sensitive cases before midterms
bullets: AP reports several politically charged Justice Department actions near Election Day.
Cases include probes involving Ilhan Omar, ex-FBI officials and James Comey.
The moves revive scrutiny of Justice Department election-season practices.

articles.title: US parties face midterm crossroads as Trump era nears transition point
bullets: AP says both major parties are reassessing strategies before midterm voting.
Democrats face pressure from younger activists and leadership critics.
Republicans are working to preserve Trump-aligned congressional strength.

articles.title: California election officials face DOJ subpoenas in voting probe
bullets: Reports say DOJ issued subpoenas to California election officials.
The probe concerns alleged noncitizen voting and voter-roll records.
A federal judge recently questioned parts of the administration’s process.

articles.title: White House hosts Halloween event as campaign season intensifies
bullets: AP’s Oct. 30 video roundup highlighted a White House Halloween celebration.
President Trump and Melania Trump hosted the event in Washington.
The event came days before consequential midterm elections.

articles.title: Canada and EU push closer alliance amid Trump trade pressure
bullets: AP’s Oct. 30 roundup led with Canada-EU alliance efforts.
The talks come amid renewed US trade pressure under Trump.
The story reflects shifting transatlantic economic diplomacy.

articles.title: Russian drone strike kills 14 at Dnipro rail platform
bullets: The Guardian reported outrage across Europe after the Dnipro strike.
EU leaders called the attack cruel and devastating.
The report appeared in its Ukraine war briefing for day 1,710.

articles.title: China expels record number from Communist Party amid Xi purges
bullets: The Guardian reported a record number of party expulsions.
Empty seats at a political meeting signaled the purge’s scale.
The expulsions reflect intensified discipline under Xi Jinping.

articles.title: Mayon volcano erupts in the Philippines, sending ash plume skyward
bullets: Horizon reported Mayon volcano ejected ash 3,000 meters high.
The update cited reporting from The Straits Times.
Authorities monitored the eruption’s impact on nearby communities.

articles.title: Bhutan glacial lake rupture triggers flooding alerts
bullets: Horizon reported flooding after a glacial lake rupture in Bhutan.
No injuries were reported in the initial update.
Alerts extended to northern West Bengal and Assam.

articles.title: Rupee steadies, heading for strongest month since February
bullets: Reuters reported the rupee was little changed near 95.25 per dollar.
The currency was on track for a 0.6% October gain.
Traders cited RBI measures curbing dollar demand.

articles.title: Indian news publishers challenge privacy law in Supreme Court
bullets: Twenty-one publishers challenged India’s privacy legislation in court.
They warned the law could threaten investigative journalism.
The case was included in Tabla’s weekly India roundup.

articles.title: India protests intensify over voter-roll review
bullets: The Atlantic reported demonstrations over India’s voter-roll revision.
The review has reportedly removed more than 130 million citizens.
Protesters demanded accountability from election officials.

articles.title: Rahul Gandhi case tied to 2018 Amit Shah remark advances
bullets: Tabla cited Reuters reporting on the defamation-related case.
The case stems from a 2018 election speech.
The remark allegedly described Amit Shah as a murder accused.

articles.title: New Zealand–India trade deal begins implementation
bullets: Recent India timelines noted the trade agreement took effect Oct. 20.
The deal marks a new phase in bilateral trade ties.
It remained part of India’s late-October policy backdrop.

articles.title: Alphabet slide drags Wall Street lower after revenue miss
bullets: Reuters reported Alphabet tumbled more than 12% after results.
Investors focused on AI spending and disappointing revenue.
The selloff weighed on major US stock indexes.

articles.title: Amazon falls after cautious holiday-quarter sales outlook
bullets: Amazon issued a cautious fourth-quarter sales outlook.
Third-quarter results missed Wall Street expectations.
AWS revenue rose 39.3% to $46 billion.

articles.title: Intel slumps after softer-than-expected fourth-quarter outlook
bullets: AP reported Intel dropped more than 25% premarket.
The company cited continued weakness in personal computers.
Intel’s outlook weighed on US futures Friday.

articles.title: Eli Lilly jumps after earnings beat and raised guidance
bullets: StreetInsider’s Reuters feed listed Eli Lilly among major movers.
The stock rose after an earnings beat.
The company also raised guidance.

articles.title: Micron dips as Samsung weakness spreads to memory peers
bullets: StreetInsider’s Reuters feed reported pressure on Micron shares.
The move followed Samsung’s post-earnings selloff.
Memory-chip names remained sensitive to AI-demand concerns.

articles.title: Amazon reports strong cloud growth but cautious outlook
bullets: AWS sales rose 39.3% in the quarter ended Sept. 30.
Amazon said it is installing AI chips rapidly.
Holiday-quarter guidance disappointed Wall Street.

articles.title: Oil prices settle lower as diplomacy hopes offset supply worries
bullets: StreetInsider’s Reuters feed reported lower oil settlement prices.
Diplomacy hopes offset some Middle East supply concerns.
Energy markets remained sensitive to Strait of Hormuz risks.

articles.title: Boeing drops after warning on 737 MAX delivery targets
bullets: Axios reported Boeing fell 10.7% in its stock spotlight.
The company said it would miss 737 MAX delivery targets.
Boeing also pushed back monthly production targets.

articles.title: Markets brace for jobs data, earnings and midterms
bullets: Reuters said next week brings jobs data and major earnings.
Investors remain focused on AI-related spending risks.
Midterms may influence the outlook for AI regulation.

articles.title: Exxon and Chevron earnings draw focus in busy reporting slate
bullets: FinanceAI listed ExxonMobil and Chevron earnings due Oct. 30.
Energy majors reported amid elevated crude prices.
Investors watched profits, production and shareholder-return updates.

articles.title: AI spending fears hit global technology shares
bullets: Reuters reported tech shares slumped on Friday.
Investors questioned whether massive AI spending will pay off.
Bond markets rallied as investors sought safety.

articles.title: Asian chip firms cite strong AI demand despite market jitters
bullets: Reuters reported AI demand remained strong across Asian chip suppliers.
SK Hynix, TSMC and Advantest shares came under pressure.
Investors weighed growth against AI-infrastructure return concerns.

articles.title: Malaysia seizes $12 million in advanced AI chips hidden in servers
bullets: Officials found 30 servers containing advanced chips at Kuala Lumpur airport.
The chips were reportedly worth about $12 million.
Authorities suspect Malaysia was used as a transit hub.

articles.title: OpenAI reportedly plans to buy Google AI chips
bullets: Reuters cited The Information on OpenAI’s chip-purchase plans.
The move would broaden OpenAI’s AI-computing supply options.
AI companies continue ramping spending for compute demand.

articles.title: Security experts warn of ‘Black October’ software flaws
bullets: Axios reported experts dubbed the month ‘Black October.’
AI-discovered flaws and attacks hit platforms powering the AI boom.
Researchers said some PHP vulnerabilities remained difficult to exploit.
